summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K disclosing submission of an Orphan Drug Designation request to the FDA for intranasal foralumab in Multiple System Atrophy, a rare neurodegenerative disease with roughly 0.6 per 100,000 person-years incidence. The FDA's Office of Orphan Products Development targets a 90-day review. If granted, benefits include seven years of market exclusivity, tax credits, fee waivers and protocol assistance. The candidate is in a Phase 2a open-label trial (NCT06868628) at Brigham and Women's Hospital. No deal terms, board recommendation or advisors; no special-situation mechanics. Watch ODD outcome and trial data, not arbitrage.
